messages:
emily-support: Customer ORG-907 reports sharp p95/p99 regressions on /v1/generate starting ~02:45 UTC. Short prompts (\"hi\") p95: 380ms -> 2.4s, p99: 1.2s -> 7.8s. Attached curl. Need urgent triage.

rohan-sre: ping infra/runtime. Which pool? Any config changes?

emily-support: Dedicated eu-central-pool (a100-shared), customer says no changes.

miguel-runtime: checking. Any deploys 01:30-03:00 UTC?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: runtime: v3.2.7 rolled eu-central at 2026-03-18T01:12:01Z. config image bump rdx-node-2026-03-17 included kernel 6.5.2 and nvidia-driver 555.00.

yana-infra: we also pushed package with nvme fw 4.05 and changed fstab to use discard=on (to reclaim space). Mount options were altered by image builder.

rohan-sre: pulling host metrics... nvme avg lat spikes at 02:44, iowait up, dmesg shows nvme timeout entries.

miguel-runtime: runtime traces show KV cache fsyncs cluster-wide aligning with request end. Under load these syncs are synchronous and short, but if disk hangs, tail explodes.

emily-support: repro curl:
```
curl -X POST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-mini","input":"hi"}'
```
Single-shot repros show spikes.

rohan-sre: quick mitigations: route ORG-907 to legacy nodepool (eu-central-legacy) and set runtime kv_async=true (skip fsync) and max_batch_size=1.

yana-infra: I can spin legacy pool and add label for routing. Also can cordon suspect nodes. ETA 10m to bring up legacy nodes.

miguel-runtime: I'll add per-org override to disable sync-fsync and reduce KV flush workers. Pushing now.

deploy-bot: routing update: override for org-id=ORG-907 applied; rollout in progress.

monitoring-bot: alert: p99_latency.api.generate.eu-central increased 2026-03-18T02:45:12Z. Incident INC-ORG907-20260318 created.

rohan-sre: on an affected node, `nvme id-ctrl /dev/nvme0` shows fw 4.05. Vendor notes that fw 4.05 interactions with kernel 6.5 can cause long completion times when discard operations are active.

yana-infra: fstab change added `discard=on` mount option to background trim monthly; that may have triggered heavy discard activity shortly after boot.

miguel-runtime: tests on staging: image with driver 555+kernel6.5+fw4.05 p99 ~7.2s; image with 552+kernel6.4+fw3.98 p99 ~1.1s. Repro consistent.

rohan-sre: vendor-bot: opened case with vendor; attached nvme traces and dmesg.

vendor-bot: vendor-case-4421 created. Vendor recommends rolling back fw to 3.98 OR disabling discard until patch available.

yana-infra: plan: 1) keep ORG-907 on legacy pool; 2) roll image back for eu-central dedicated pool to rdx-node-2026-03-01 (no discard patch, fw 3.98); 3) schedule fw rollback/patch with vendor in maintenance window. Starting image rollback now.

miguel-runtime: added runtime safeguard: if node iowait > 20% then mark node unhealthy for routing and throttle KV flushers. Deployed to control plane.

emily-support: customer reports p99 down to ~1.3s after routing change. Thank you.

rohan-sre: collecting logs for postmortem: nvme smart, dmesg, iostat samples, kernel boot configs.

yana-infra: image rollback started at 2026-03-18T03:00:10Z. Will watch for normalization.

monitoring-bot: update: p99_latency.api.generate.eu-central normalized at 2026-03-18T03:18:45Z.

miguel-runtime: follow-ups: add KV small-sync IO test to pre-release CI, add gate for nvme fw + kernel + driver bumps, and documentation for fstab/discard implications.

emily-support: ACTIONS: yana infra = complete rollback & vendor follow-up; rohan-sre = collect diagnostics & draft postmortem; miguel-runtime = add CI test and runtime auto-fallback; emily-support = customer comms.

rohan-sre: note: consider adding a canary that runs a low-latency KV workload during image bake to catch these regressions early.

emily-support: Customer happy with routing and ETA. Keeping ticket open until vendor confirms fw patch. :white_check_mark:
